name: anim_wani_move
subject: a huge muscular crocodile monster made of thick pink and yellow marbled liquid paint, its lower body melting into a puddle, no legs
desc: Slithering forward to the left on its melted puddle base like a slug, the gooey base surging and rippling forward, upper body swaying and leaning, arms swinging heavily. Loop. Thick, sticky, viscous goo: paint sagging, stretching and dripping slowly.
